name: Berlin Theatertreffen 2026
venue: Berliner Festspiele: Haus der Berliner Festspiele
description: Every year in May, Berlin hosts Theatertreffen, an event that showcases the very best of German-language theatre while fostering dialogue and collaboration among artists and audiences alike. This prestigious festival selects ten outstanding productions from hundreds across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, offering a unique platform for creative performances, insightful discussions and critical reflection on the role of theatre in society.
